Summary
: The English translation of the Mandukya Upanishad including the commentary of Madhva called the Bhasya. The describe the secret meaning of Om as the four names and aspects of the Lord (Vishva, Taijasa, Prajna and Turiya). This Upanishad is associated with the Atharva Veda and contains tweelve verses although Madhva reads the Gaudapada’s Karikas as part of the text. 
The Mundaka Upanishad is also known as: Māṇḍukya Upaniṣad (माण्डुक्य उपनिषद्), Māṇḍukyopaniṣad (माण्डुक्योपनिषद्), Mandukyopanishad, Mandukyopanisad, Māṇḍukyopaniṣat (माण्डुक्योपनिषत्), Mandukyopanishat, Mandukyopanisat.
